description: This file defines the 'Legend' class which models the legend component of a chart within the MigraDoc document object model. It includes properties for styling, formatting, and serialization, along with typical object methods like clone and deep copy.

classes.name: Legend
classes.description: Represents the legend of a chart, including styling, formatting, and serialization capabilities.

classes.name: Legend.LegendValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for the Legend class, such as Style, Format, and LineFormat.

methods.name: Legend()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing BaseValues with LegendValues.

methods.name: Legend(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Internal constructor initializing BaseValues with LegendValues and associating with a parent document object.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the Legend instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy()
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the Legend object, including cloning of nested properties.

methods.name: Serialize(Serializer serializer)
methods.description: Serializes the Legend object into a specific format, likely for DDL output.

methods.name: IsNull()
methods.description: Indicates whether the Legend is considered null; always returns false as a Legend object is always meaningful.
